title: Search-result video announces a national strike and peaceful demonstration for 24–25 October
date: 2024-10-24/25 (announced date only; not a verified event date)
reason: Not coded as an observed protest: the only saved indication is a rendered, truncated announcement; opening the YouTube URL was throttled and no actual occurrence, location, attendance, organizer, or state-directed demand was verified.
notes: This is a trace of a possible lead, not a conclusion that the announced action did not occur. The discovery response was part of an aggregate four-query call and cannot be mapped to one individual query; its full rendered response is preserved as B001.raw_tool_response.json.
